en: Sepia-toned aerial view over a small town surrounded by fields and light woodland. In the foreground are detached houses with gardens; further back stand rows of multi-storey residential buildings and a church-like structure, all set within greenery. The landscape stretches into flat countryside on the horizon. At the bottom left, white printed text reads "GERINGSWALDE. Blick vom Aussichtsturm." indicating the scene is a view of Geringswalde from an observation tower.
